main_text.p: [Hebrew word] Ch.Idem. Syris vero, Gramen, Fœnum, Grec. [Greek word]: & sic quoque Ch. Proverb.27.25.
[Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Lana. Heb. [Hebrew word]. Deinde Chald. quoque significat Tineam, Psal.39.12.
[Syriac word] Syr. Habitator, inhabitator, incola, Act.1.20. Item nomen loci, Amura, Gomorrha, ut Rom. 9. 29. Plur.emph. [Syriac word], 2.ad Cor.5.9.

[Hebrew word] Ch. & Syr. Respondere, exaudire: Deinde Syr. Anxium, solicitum, sedulum, curiosum, occupatum esse, [Syriac word] Marta autē anxia, occupata erat, Lucæ 10.40. Part. Pehil [Syriac word] Et occupati in actionibus vestris, 1.Thess.4.11. Ithpehal [Hebrew word] Exaudiri, respoderi. Pahel [Hebrew word] Respondere. Item Affligere; de cocubitu est, Comprimere, stuprare pudicitiæ violandæ causâ: de Jejunio, jejunare, jejunio affligere se. Ithpah. [Hebrew word] Affligere se. Sic & Syr. Futur. [Syriac word] Ut affligatis vos ad jejunium & orationem, 1.ad Corinth.7.5. Comprimi, subigi, violari, Thren.5.11.
[Hebrew word] Ch. Afflictus, Pauper, Miser. Plur. [Hebrew word], [Hebrew word]. Fœm. [Hebrew word], [Hebrew word].
